title: Quantitative FRET (Förster Resonance Energy Transfer) Analysis for SENP1 Protease Kinetics Determination
protocol: Amplify the open reading frames of the genes by PCR.
Clone the PCR products into PCRII-TOPO vector.
Confirm the products by sequencing.
Clone cDNA encoding CyPet-(pre-SUMO1)-YPet, CyPet-SUMO1, YPet and catalytic domains of SENP1 into pET28 (b) vector with an N-terminal hexahistidine tag.
Transform Escherichia coli cells of strain BL21 (DE3) with pET28 (b) vectors encoding the constructs.
Grow transformed bacteria in 2xYT medium for 3 hr at 37 °C shaking at 250 rpm to reach an optical density of 0.5 at 600 nm.
Add 100 μM IPTG to induce protein expression and shake for 16 hr at 25 °C at 200 rpm.
Harvest bacteria by centrifugation at 10,000 rpm at 4 °C for 5 min.
Resuspend the bacteria in a buffer of 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4), 50 mM NaCl, and 5 mM imidazole.
Sonicate cells for 10 min in 5-sec intervals at a power setting of 25 W using MiSonics 4,000 sonicator.
Collect the supernatant by centrifugation at 35,000 x g at 4 °C for 30 min.
Set up the column with 500 ml Ni-NTA beads for 1 L culture and transfer the supernatant into the column.
Wash the resin with buffer of 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4), 500 mM NaCl, and 10 mM imidazole twice.
Elute protein with buffer of 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4), 500 mM NaCl, and 500 mM imidazole.
Dialyze eluted protein into a buffer of 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4), 50 mM NaCl, and 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) at 4 °C overnight.
Determine the concentrations of purified proteins by Bradford assay.
Measure protein concentrations using SDS-PAGE gel electrophoresis followed by staining with Coomassie blue and imaging quantitative analysis.
Prepare CyPet-SUMO1 at concentrations of 50, 100, 200, 500, and 750 nM and 1 mM.
Measure emissions at 475 and 530 nm after excitation at 414 nm to determine α.
Prepare YPet at concentrations of 50, 100, 200, 500, 750, and 1,000 nM.
Measure emission at 530 nm when samples are excited by wavelengths of 414 and 475 nm to determine β.
Incubate CyPet-(pre-SUMO1)-YPet with the catalytic domain of SENP1 at 37°C in a buffer containing 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4), 50 mM NaCl, 0.1% (v/v) Tween-20, and 1 mM DTT to a total volume of 80 μl.
Transfer the reaction mixture into a 384-well plate.
Measure fluorescence emission at 475 nm after excitation at 414 nm using a fluorescence multiwell plate reader for 5 min with 15-sec intervals.
Measure fluorescence emission at 530 nm after excitation at 414 nm using the same setup as above.
